profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced in Nodejs applications, utilizing JavaScript both on the back-end and the front-end.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered AI-Native feature that allowed end-users to check potential study
candidates against sponsor criteria, thereby reducing the time for clients to
get responses as well as sponsors getting data points.

Ramped up new engineers to enterprise-ready producers of high quality
code through code reviews. 

Fostered collaboration within the team and a
culture of improvement.

Made use of the existing RFC process to introduce new processes and ideas.
Successfully persuaded many technical decisions based on these RFCs.
Pushed for and achieved adoption of using React-Router data-mode
throughout the company. Applications became snappier, quicker to navigate
and easier to reason about and maintain.

Standardized testing backend code via in-memory databases. We gained
confidence in our tests and more edge-cases to be tested.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built one-off sites for local events.
Built e-commerce websites for local musicians and artists
Support contracts with local businesses for updating client websites

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Constructed a feature that allowed customers to select from a list ofproducts and create dynamic bundles and provide a discount.

Developed a carousel showing diﬀerent recommendations source from in-house machine learning models.

Worked and maintained storefront gateway in Golang.

Built out a new feature that allowed customers to select from a list of products to create bundles at a discount
Built a new carousel where we showed different recommendations sourced from machine learning models
Taught and ramped up new team members. I have also mentored coworkers and successfully helped them achieve their work goals. 
Communicated with all disciplines (design, PM, analytics, QA) to ensure we have the right Acceptance Criteria for all projects prior to writing code. This led us to complete more projects on time with a positive effect on revenue.
Set coding standards for the team to foster consistent, high quality code and low turnaround times on new features. This led to an increase in team morale due to enabling and using linter rules to automatically catch and fix problems arising from the coding standards.
Created new microservice systems in Java.
Added features and helped to maintain a microservice written in Golang. This was necessary to move the entire Wayfair search experience to work in the new microservice architecture
Built customer-facing pages in Typescript and React.
Built new experience for customers to be able to compare and more easily purchase recommendations without needing to move pages. This resulted in a $100 million increase in revenue Year-over-Year.
Ran A/B tests for new features so that we made data-driven choices to keep successful features and remove features that are not providing value.
Ran Shadow tests to ensure customer and service stability while moving millions of requests from old to new services.
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Infrastructure and +6 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Akamai POS is a Point-of-Sale company focused on serving the local community of Honolulu, HI.

Built a faster Frontend for the Point-of-Sale product that allowed clients solved a common frustration clients had where the previous UI had seconds in delay between actions.
Created a set of common practices for testing and deploying patches to clients. Previously we had none.

projects.title: FreeCodeCamp Projects
projects.description:
The main repository I use to keep track of the projects I've made.
Through the use of git anyone can see me improve, so I find that this is a great place to keep my code.

projects.title: Knowledge Rocket
projects.description: A knowledge rocket is a blurb of information that is presented to you in multiple, simple different ways over time. This project facilitates the creation of those rockets, and getting them to students. It is a full-stack application built over the course of four weeks alongside a team of talented individuals. This project is built using the popular MERN stack.  My two proudest contributions to this project were integrating an email api into our custom scheduling system and setting up continuous integration into the project.
